authority_basis.summary: Record the generic Gram-boundary nearby-cycle calculation.

operations.title: The generic Gram degeneration has trivial node-cycle inertia
operations.body: At a generic rank-two Gram boundary the node family has normal form W^2-x3^2-s(x1^2+x2^2)=0. Its Hessian discriminant has order two; the Kummer deck transformation flips x1 and x2 and therefore acts by +1 on the vanishing three-cycle.

operations.title: Generic Gram normal-form and Kummer-orientation audit
operations.body: The exact checker derives adj(diag(1,1,s))=diag(s,s,1), special-fiber factorization, discriminant order two, and determinant +1 for the two-coordinate Kummer deck action.

operations.title: Benincasa closes generic Gram inertia for the four-site nodes
operations.body: Entry 1175: at generic detG=0 the local form is W²-x3²-s(x1²+x2²)=0. The Kummer trivialization flips two coordinates around s=0, hence acts by +1 on the vanishing S3. Generic codimension-one Gram specialization adds no inertia beyond the existing Gram divisor/Kummer normalization. The next possible excess is only on deeper rank(G)<=1 intersections.
